profile.gtm_customer_evidence: Forty paying customers. Two published case studies.
profile.gtm_constraints: We only take customers in the UK and Ireland.

brand_facts.offer: Accounts payable software for mid-sized distributors. Pricing: a flat monthly fee per entity.
brand_facts.customer:
Finance teams of two to ten people at distributors with several legal entities.

Not a fit: companies with fewer than 200 invoices a month.
brand_facts.problem: Invoices arrive faster than the team can code and approve them.
brand_facts.triggers:
Trigger: month-end close slipped twice in a row.

Why now: e-invoicing rules take effect next year.
brand_facts.difference: Alternatives are spreadsheets, the ERP's own module and outsourced bookkeeping.

competitors.name: PayStack Pro
competitors.what: Self-serve payables tool with invoice capture

competitors.name: Northbook
competitors.what: Outsourced bookkeeping with a monthly close service
competitors.charges: Monthly retainer plus a fee per entity
